name: Overwhelm
text: Inflicts damage beyond what would kill the target(s) to the enemy Nexus.

name: Burst
text: Can be played whenever you may act. Happens instantly and allows you to continue to play other cards.

name: Countdown
text: Round Start: I count down 1. At 0, activate the Countdown effect, then destroy me.

name: Play
text: Get this effect when you play this unit from hand.

name: Landmark
text: Landmarks take up a space on the board. They can't attack, block, or take damage.

name: Capture
text: A Captured card is removed from the game. It returns when the Capturing unit leaves play.

name: Attack
text: Get this effect when this unit attacks.

name: Story: Slow
text: Activatable once per round. When activated, play the skill of the current Act at Slow speed, then transform me to the next Act.

name: Attach
text: Attach me to an ally to give it my stats and keywords while I'm attached. When that ally leaves play, Recall me.

name: Story: Focus
text: Activatable once per round. When activated, play the skill of the current Act at Focus speed, then transform me to the next Act.

name: Fleeting
text: Fleeting cards discard from hand when the round ends.

name: Elemental Skill
text: A unit's spell-like effect that allows enemy reactions. It's elemental!

name: Nab
text: Draw a non-champion card from the bottom of the enemy deck.

name: Focus
text: Can be played outside combat or when no other spells or skills are pending. Happens instantly and allows you to continue to play other cards.

name: Enlightened
text: You're Enlightened when you have 10 max mana.

name: Invoke
text: Pick a Celestial card from among 3 to create in hand.

name: Flow
text: A card activates its Flow on Round Start if you played 2+ spells or skills last round.

name: Boon
text: Attaches to another card in a deck. When that card is drawn, activate the effect.

name: Trap
text: Attaches to another card in a deck. When that card is drawn, activate the effect.

name: Drain
text: Heal your Nexus for the amount of damage dealt

name: Last Breath
text: These abilities take effect when the unit dies.

name: Level Up
text: A champion in play levels up everywhere once this condition is met. Some champions must be in play to see their condition progress.

name: Fast
text: Can be played whenever you may act. Happens after your opponent has a chance to react.

name: Recall
text: Return a unit to hand and remove all effects applied to it.

name: Weakest
text: Lowest Power, with ties broken by lowest Health then lowest Cost

name: Support
text: Attacking with a support unit will buff the unit to its right.

name: Slow
text: Can be played outside of combat when no spells or skills are pending. Happens after your opponent has a chance to react.

name: Imbue
text: These abilities trigger when you resolve a spell.

name: Equipment
text: Equip to a unit to grant the listed bonuses. If the unit leaves play, the equipment will return to your hand. You may play each equipment at most once per round.

name: Nightfall
text: Bonus if this is NOT the first card you play in a round.

name: Attune
text: When I'm summoned, refill 1 spell mana.

name: Daybreak
text: Bonus if this is the FIRST card you play in a round.

name: Skill
text: A unit's spell-like effect that allows enemy reactions.

name: Plunder
text: A card activates its plunder ability when played if you damaged the enemy Nexus this round.

name: Double Attack
text: While attacking, it strikes both before AND at the same time as its blocker.

name: Vulnerable
text: The enemy can challenge this unit, forcing it to block.

name: Elusive
text: Can only be blocked by an Elusive unit.

name: Stun
text: Remove a unit from combat. It can't attack or block for the rest of the round.

name: Curse
text: Applies a negative effect as long as it's in hand. Multiples of the same curse on a unit combine, increasing their cost and effect. Cannot be targeted in hand.

name: Fated
text: Each round, the first time an allied card targets me, grant me +1|+1.

name: Sharpsight
text: Can block Elusive units

name: Fury
text: When I kill a unit, grant me +1|+1.

name: Barrier
text: Negates the next damage the unit would take. Lasts one round.

name: Immobile
text: Can't attack or block.

name: Hallowed
text: After I die, for the rest of the game when allies attack, hallow your first attacker giving it +1|+0 that round

name: Evolve
text: I have +2|+2 once you've had Units with 6+ other unique positive keywords in play this game.

name: Frostbite
text: Set a unit's Power to 0 this round. It can be changed after.

name: Quick Attack
text: While attacking, strikes before its blocker.

name: Spirit
text: This unit has +1|+1. This keyword can stack.

name: Tough
text: Takes 1 less damage from all sources.

name: Regeneration
text: Heals fully at the end of each round.

name: Silenced
text: Removes all text and keywords from a unit.

name: SpellShield
text: Negates the next enemy spell or skill that would affect me.

name: Lifesteal
text: Damage this unit deals heals its Nexus that amount.

name: Gloom
text: This unit has -1|-1. This keyword can stack.

name: Augment
text: When you play a created card, grant me +1|+0.

name: Impact
text: When this strikes while attacking, it deals 1 to the enemy Nexus. This keyword can stack.

name: Scout
text: The first time only Scout units attack each round, ready your attack.

name: Ephemeral
text: This unit dies when it strikes or when the round ends.

name: Lurk
text: When you attack while I'm on top of your deck, I Lurk, granting Lurker allies everywhere +1|+0. Max once per round.

name: Formidable
text: I strike with my Health instead of my Power.

name: Deathless
text: The next time this unit dies, remove Deathless and revive it Stunned with 1 Health.

name: Brash
text: Can only be blocked by enemies with 3 or more Health.

name: Challenger
text: Can choose which enemy unit blocks.

name: Fearsome
text: Can only be blocked by enemies with 3 or more Power.

name: Allegiance
text: When you summon this unit, it gets its allegiance bonus if the top card of your deck matches its region.

name: Phase
text: Pick the next Moon Weapon for Aphelios.

name: Reforge
text: Create a random Blade Fragment still needed to restore the blade. Once you’ve played all 3, create the Blade of the Exile.

name: Disguise
text: Secretly transforms into another unit before entering play. They won't reveal their true identity to your opponent until they leave play or level up.

name: Restore the Sun Disc
text: Immediately draw 1 of each Ascended ally. For the rest of the game, level 2 Ascended allies are level 3.

name: Attack Strike
text: Effect when unit strikes with an attack

name: Spawn
text:
For each Spawn:
Summon a 1|1 Tentacle, or if you already have one, grant your strongest Tentacle +1|+1.

name: Strongest
text: Highest Power, with ties broken by highest Health then highest Cost.

name: Toss
text: Obliterate X non-champion cards from the bottom of your deck.

name: Blade Dance
text: Start a free attack with that many summoned Blades.

name: Behold
text: You behold something if you have it in play or hand.

name: Terrify
text: Obliterate X cards from the top of the enemy deck, activating any traps on them.

name: Round End
text: Get this effect when the round ends.

name: Titanic
text: Units with 8+ power or health

name: Obliterate
text: Completely removed from the game. Doesn't cause Last Breath and can't be revived.

name: Sleep
text: Obliterate a unit and recall its attachments to store an exact copy in a landmark for one round.

name: Updraft
text: Shuffle a card into its player's deck and reduce its cost by 1

name: Improvise
text: Choose one of two random options from a depleting pool of equipment and equip it to this ally. If the ally wasn't played from hand, it equips a random equipment instead.

name: Boost
text: Increase allies' positive stackable keywords or enemies' negative stackable keywords.

name: Origin
text: This champion counts as one of your deck's regions. During deckbuilding, you may add the specified cards to your deck regardless of region. Origins may also have an effect that begins at Start of Game.

name: Strike
text: Get this effect when a unit attempts to deal damage using its Power, either at the end of battle or with spells. Units with 0 Power can't strike.

name: Animate
text: For each allied target, summon a 1|1 Ephemeral unit. Copy the animated spell onto them.

name: Nexus Strike
text: Effect when unit Strikes the enemy Nexus.

name: Empowered
text: A unit has its Empowered bonus while its Power is at least the listed number.

name: Reputation
text: Activates if allies have struck for 5+ damage at least 4 times this game.

name: Equip
text: Equipping an Item to a unit grants it the listed bonuses. If the unit leaves play, the Item will return to your hand. You may play each item at most once per round.

name: Recast
text: When you play this spell, create in hand a fleeting copy of it with +1 cost.

name: Round Start
text: Get this effect when the round starts.

name: Forge
text: Grant an ally +1|+1. If the ally is equipped, grant it to their item instead.

name: Everywhere
text: In play, in hand, in deck, in discard, and even if created/summoned later.

name: Advance
text: Makes a Countdown landmark count down that many times

name: Rally
text: If you don't have one, gain the attack token. You can attack this round.

name: Slay
text: When you kill a unit via damage, kill effect, or striking it with an ally. (Self-killing, like from Ephemeral, doesn't count.)

name: Gathering Storm
text: Reduce the cost of Storm Conduits in your hand by 1.

name: Silence
text: Remove all keywords, abilities, and ongoing effects. Doesn't affect damage or subtype.

name: Manifest
text: Create in hand 1 of 3 randomly selected cards.

name: Ambush
text: Can be played hidden if you have no other hidden Ambush allies. Hidden allies are 2 cost 2|2s. You may pay a hidden ally's Ambush cost to transform it into its base card.

name: Critical Strike
text: This has a chance to deal double damage.

name: Predict
text: Pick a card from among 3 in your deck. Put that card on top and place the others in your deck.
